# June Women's Health - Specialist Gynecology & Obstetrics Clinic

> June Women's Health is a specialized women's health, maternity, and laparoscopic surgery clinic located in Sushant Golf City, Lucknow, led by Dr. Shamim Sultana Yashine (MS - Obstetrics & Gynaecology, FMAS). Offering expert, compassionate, and evidence-based clinical care across all stages of a woman's life.

## Clinic Overview
- **Name**: June Women's Health
- **Lead Specialist**: Dr. Shamim Sultana Yashine (MS - Obstetrician & Gynaecologist, Laparoscopic Surgeon, Infertility Specialist)
- **Clinical Experience**: 15+ Years of Dedicated Women's Healthcare Experience
- **Specializations**: Fertility Management, Advanced Laparoscopic & Hysteroscopic Surgeries, High-Risk Pregnancy, Normal Delivery, Scarless Hysterectomy, Cervical Cancer Screening & Prevention

## Core Clinical & Surgical Services

### Maternity & Pregnancy Care
- [Normal Delivery](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/normal-delivery-in-lucknow/): Evidence-based labor support promoting safe natural vaginal delivery with minimal interventions.
- [High-Risk Pregnancy Management](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/high-risk-pregnancy-management-in-lucknow/): Comprehensive care for gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, recurrent pregnancy loss, and advanced maternal age.
- [LSCS / Caesarean Section](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/lscs-caesarean-section-in-lucknow/): Safe surgical childbirth with meticulous cosmetic suturing and rapid recovery protocols.
- [Comprehensive Pregnancy Care](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/pregnancy-care-in-lucknow/): Routine antenatal checkups, fetal growth scans, nutritional counseling, and postpartum wellness.
- [Pre-Conceptional Counselling](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/pre-conceptional-counselling-in-lucknow/): Pre-pregnancy health screenings, genetic risk evaluation, and fertility preparation.
- [Lactational Counselling](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/lactational-counselling-in-lucknow/): Personalized breastfeeding guidance, latch correction, and postpartum lactation support.

### Infertility & Reproductive Health
- [Infertility, IUI & IVF Evaluation](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/infertility-iui-ivf-in-lucknow/): Ovulation induction, follicular monitoring, IUI procedures, and advanced reproductive guidance.
- [PCOD & PCOS Care](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/pcod-pcos-care-in-lucknow/): Holistic hormonal balancing, lifestyle modification, menstrual regulation, and metabolic care.
- [Tubal Ligation Reversal](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/tubal-ligation-reversal-in-lucknow/): Precision microsurgical fallopian tube recanalization for restoring natural fertility.

### Advanced Minimally Invasive Gynaecological Surgeries
- [Laparoscopic Procedures](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/laparoscopic-procedures-in-lucknow/): Keyhole surgeries for ovarian cysts, fibroids, endometriosis, and ectopic pregnancies.
- [Hysteroscopy Procedures](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/hysteroscopy-in-lucknow/): Diagnostic and operative hysteroscopy for uterine polyps, septa, adhesions, and abnormal uterine bleeding.
- [Scarless Hysterectomy / NDVH](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/scarless-hysterectomy-in-lucknow/): Non-descent vaginal hysterectomy with no abdominal incisions, minimal discomfort, and swift recovery.

### Preventive Oncology & Women's Wellness
- [Cervical Cancer Screening & HPV Vaccination](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/cervical-cancer-vaccination-screening-in-lucknow/): Liquid-based cytology Pap smears, HPV DNA testing, and preventive vaccination regimens.
- [Comprehensive Cancer Screening](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/cancer-screening-in-lucknow/): Early screening for breast, cervical, uterine, and ovarian malignancies.
- [Menstrual Cycle Problems](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/menstrual-cycle-problems-in-lucknow/): Diagnostic evaluation and treatment for menorrhagia, dysmenorrhea, oligomenorrhea, and hormonal irregularities.
- [Menstrual Hygiene & Health](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/menstrual-hygiene-in-lucknow/): Reproductive tract infection prevention, sustainable hygiene practices, and teenage wellness.
- [Pubertal Counselling](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/pubertal-counselling-in-lucknow/): Adolescent healthcare addressing puberty onset, body changes, and menstrual education.
- [Pelvic Infections Treatment](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/pelvic-infections-treatment-in-lucknow/): Treatment for Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID), recurrent vaginitis, and urinary tract infections.
- [Contraception & Family Planning](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/contraception-advice-in-lucknow/): Tailored birth control advice, oral pills, injectable contraceptives, and barrier counseling.
- [Family Planning Center & IUD Services](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/family-planning-center-in-lucknow/): Copper-T and hormonal IUD (Mirena) insertions and reproductive autonomy guidance.
- [Confidential MTP / D&E Services](https://junewomenshealthclinic.com/mtp-d-e-services-in-lucknow/): Safe, legal, and confidential medical and surgical termination of pregnancy compliant with MTP Act regulations.
